key_insight: LLM-simulated clients showed both similarities and differences to human role-players in counselling communication patterns, suggesting potential for training rather than equivalence.
engineering_relevance: Sentence-level communication analysis offers a way to assess and refine LLM-based virtual clients for counselling practice.
method: Record novice counsellors role-playing with human peers acting as clients.
Conduct role-plays with clients simulated by Mixtral 8x7B using 4-bit quantization.
Compare sentence-level counselling patterns and counsellor behaviour across scenarios.
evidence_signal: Recorded human-client and LLM-client interactions were evaluated using a sentence-level counselling communication pattern system; the abstract reports no sample sizes or quantitative effect estimates.
watch_item: Communication-pattern similarities alone do not establish authentic client behaviour or improved counselling competencies.
paper_title: Comparing Human Role-Players and LLM-Simulated Clients in Online Counselling Training: An Analysis of Counselling Patterns
